Legendary Big Mining Drill from Raw Inputs

**To start:**
- Connect inputs
- The factory will bootstrap itself and will take care of its power needs

**Quality Items**
- All items are normal quality, except the quality modules.
- If you need legendary quality modules, you can use [this blueprint](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OYm5voVv8s_NWx0wkey)

**Update 11/10/2025** - Fixed 2 possible deadlocks
